MR-I READYTHORACIC SPINE

Set the patient up on the spine array, run the 3-plane localiser — and a C-spine localiser if you need to see where the spine starts — plan the sagittals from C7 to L1, then tilt the axials square to the canal
Demonstration only — an educational simulation of MRI planning, not a medical device, not for clinical use. Every image comes from one real, de-identified thoracic spine MRI in a public research collection (Cancer Moonshot Biobank – Multiple Myeloma Collection, The Cancer Imaging Archive, CC BY 4.0), shown with its true geometry; the clinical request is fictional — see the credits on the results screen.
